# SplashLearn

> SplashLearn is a gamified PreK-Grade 5 math and English learning platform with curriculum-aligned activities, teacher resources, and adaptive homeschool programs.

SplashLearn serves millions of students through interactive educational games and comprehensive lesson plans aligned to Common Core standards. The platform is used by teachers, parents, and homeschoolers to supplement classroom learning with engaging digital activities.

## Key Topics

- Math curriculum
- ELA (English Language Arts)
- Common Core standards
- Grade levels (PreK-5)
- Homeschool program
- Teacher resources
- Educational games
- Online learning
- Adaptive learning
- Lesson plans
- Parent resources
- Virtual manipulatives
- Summer learning
- Free activities
- Elementary education

- [Grade 2 Resources](https://www.splashlearn.com/2nd-graders): Curriculum-aligned Grade 2 math & ELA resources

- [Grade 5 Resources](https://www.splashlearn.com/5th-graders): Curriculum-aligned Grade 5 math & ELA resources

## Core Learning Programs

- [Math Curriculum & Activities](https://www.splashlearn.com/math): CCSS-aligned math curriculum with free activities for PreK-5
- [ELA Curriculum & Activities](https://www.splashlearn.com/ela): Reading & writing activities with curriculum resources for PreK-5
- [Homeschool Math Program](https://www.splashlearn.com/homeschool-program): Adaptive PreK-5 math program designed for homeschoolers with parent testimonials
